{{Quote|He's a Trandoshan named Hrodius Goragg. He has connections with Bossk but I don't believe he's called in his comrade on this bounty. We need to remove this killer quickly.|Kima Nazith to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Hrodius Goragg''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He had connections with [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], another more well known Trandoshan bounty hunter. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[High Inquisitor]] [[Mal Sikander]] hired Goragg to bring in [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Pooja Naberrie/Legends|Pooja Naberrie]] dead or alive. The bodyguard [[Kima Nazith]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with killing Goragg.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Hrodius Goragg was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
